title: Autotune have wrong Profile
body: I'm using the dev-d version. When I run Autotune, the profile it uses contains completely incorrect data. I only have one profile, so I can rule out the possibility that I selected the wrong one. Have erveryone a idea what's wrong or what's I do wrong.

comments.body:
My only explain how this could be possible is with these steps:
- Autotune run has been done using current running profile as the input (not by a manual selection of one explicit profile in dropdown menu).
- profile within ProfilePlugin has been updated recently (with latest values shared within your screenshot)
- latest updated profile has never been explicitely applied with a profilSwitch action done after the update (so your current running profile is still the one before latest update).

To confirm this issue, you should provide, not only the screenshot of profile values within plugin, but also a screenshot of current running profile done from overview (with profile button).

With your latest screenshot I'm lost because all the different profiles shared are different:
- the one in your profile plugin: rate at 1:00 = 1.30 U/h
- the autotune input profile: rate at 1:00 = 0.893 U/h
- the autotune calculated profile: rate at 1:00 = 1.161 U/h
- your current running profile: rate at 1:00 = 1.22 U/h

Could you please explain, starting from now with the list of all starting point situation (including screenshots  done now on plugin, overview and Autotune with the screenshot of profileView button for input profile)?

Within Autotune, the button "Check Input profile" is here to show the detailed information of the selected input profile:
![Screenshot_20251110-130602_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3b4cdd24-938c-4ca4-aa7f-a91a078b87cc)

You can compare and check:
- default selection (click before any run or results what is the default)
- explicit selection of current active profile in profile list
- explicit selection of the profile with profilePlugin

Then compare and share selection.

Keep also in mind that the green link in Autotune (Last run) will show the latest run synthesis (this run can be old so both input side and output side can be outdated and no more consistant with current situation).
I have click to the Button. The Profile is correct. When I klick Autotune the profile Information are wrong.

Sorry I'm still confused:
- when you select a profile with autotune, or when you change one parameter (i.e. number of day selected) the result area should be empty 

At this step I would like to see the manual selected profile in the autotune top dropdown menu (first by selecting "<Active>") and share the "check input profile results" and the equivalent screenshots of Current Running Profile from main OverView (both profiles should be the same)
And then Run Autotune and share a new screenshot with corresponding results.

You can then provide me the same kind of screenshots, but this time with the selection of "Normal" profile in Autotune Dropdown menu (and the corresponding profile should be the basal rates tab within Profile Plugin).

Can you also precise which branch and used (Autotune Plugin is not available in master)... Is it from main AndroidAPS repo, from latest dev or older version (which commit), using AAPS or AAPSCLIENT version...

Sorry to ask you so many screenshots and information, but I'm not able to reproduce your issue and neither understand what should I do to try reproduce it 🤔.
I using AAPS. The New dev.

Thanks, very strange, it looks like you have an hard coded profile as input (whatever your selection, you always have the same starting point within AT)
- will check on latest dev if something can explains this
